senses.gloss: Maghā, mostly pl. (ºāḥ), name of a nakshatra (v. Su. Si.).-§ 246 (Sundopasundop.): I, 210, 7653 (ºāsu).--§ 370 (Tīrthayātrāp.): III, 84, 8029 (Kṛttikā-Mºyoḥ…tīrthaṃ). --§ 574 (Jambūkh.): VI, 3, 81 (ºāsv Aṅgārako vakraḥ, omens). --§ 576 (Bhagavadgītāp.): VI, 17, 637 (ºvishayago somaḥ).-§ 746 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 64, 3263 (ºāsu, the merit of making gifts under the constellation of M.).--§ 749 (do.): XIII, 88, 4251 (ºāsu), 4252 (do.); 89, 4259 (ºāsu, the merit of performing a śrāddha under the constellation of M.). --§ 759 (do.): XIII, 110, 5394 (ºāṃ, sg., description of the cāndravrata, cf. Aśleshāḥ).--§ 766 (do.): XIII, 126, 6040 (sg., a śrāddha should be performed under the constellation of M.).

Māgha, name of a month. § 587 (Bhīshmavadhap.): VI, 119, 5632 (ºmāse gavā iva, but B. reads māghamāṃ segavā iva, cf. the explanation of Nīl.).--§ 733p (Gaṅgā-Yamunayos tīrthaṃ): XIII, 25, 1724 (ºmāse, then one should bathe in Prayāga).--§ 746 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 66, 3316 (ºmāse, the merit of gifts of seeds in the month of M.).--§ 759 (do.): XIII, 106, 5152 (ºmāsaṃ, the merit of fasting during M.); 109, 5374 (dvādaśyāṃ Mºmāse, then one should worship Kṛshṇa as Mādhava).--§ 777 (Svargārohanik. p.): XIII, 168, 7733 (māsaḥ, the month in which Bhīshma died). --§ 785 (Anugītāp.): XIV, 85, 2513 (dvādaśīṃ Mºpākshikīṃ; ºmāsikīṃ, B.).

Māghī, the day of full moon in the month of Māgha. § 658b (Kṛtaghnop.): XII, 171, 6384 (on this day the Rākshasa king entertained brahmans).--§ 733p (GaṅgāYamunayos tīrthaṃ): XIII, 25, 1723 (on this day 30,010,000 tīrthas are assembled in Prayāga).--§ 751b (Śapathavidhi): XIII, 94, 4552 (on this day Śukra, etc., came to Kauśikī).--§ 785 (Anugītāp.): XIV, 85, 2517 (paurṇamāsī).
